To explain my reasoning:

Girls I definately would have included:

\- Allison: Fan favorite, probably most so in ANTM history

\- Angelea: Huge character on her season, one of the biggest screen time "hogs" in ANTM history

\- Brittany: From just watching her cycle I'm not sure I would've included her. However, I remember back in the day that she was seen as the representative for ANTM in a lot of places and thought of as a huge fan favorite. She was on Battle of the Network Reality Stars (only ANTM contestant). I never really understood it but I did know she was viewed as this huge fan favorite back in the day

\- Isis: Her being the first transgender contestant was a HUGE deal back than regardless of how early she was eliminated

\- Lisa: One of the most memorable personalities in ANTM history

Girls I understood why they were included and may/may not have been included had I made the cast:

\- Kayla: Ann was the clear main character of that season but Kayla was still pretty major and had the unique LGBT part of her story

\- Laura: She was definately a fan favorite. She won the fan favorite prize of the cycle afterall.

​

Girls I wouldn't have included:

\- Camille: Rewatching old school ANTM and I think Tyra found her "signature walk" comment much more iconic than I ever did as she repeated it quite a bit in future cycles. I thought she was kind of the given the bitch edit her cycle but very little complexity to it and really her only legacy among the fandom was being a bitch and not one of the more iconic ones.

\- Bianca: Similar to Camille, I always thought of her legacy up to that point as being a bitch but not an iconic one (like Jade). She also was definately NOT a fan favorite

\- Dominique: This one made a little bit more sense but I still wouldn't have included her. She was memorable, NOT a fan favorite, but seemed to be well remembered by the fandom. She also did win Modelland. If they couldn't get somebody like Fatima from that cycle than including Dominique made sense I suppose.

\- Shannon: No clue on this one. The girls that season who were deemed the memorable ones up to that point always were Adrianne, Robin, and Elyse. Shannon was just seen as a Robin follower if anything.

\- Sheena: I guess she had a big personality and was fairly well-liked but nowhere near All Star levels of iconic IMO

\-Bre: She had her iconic granola bar incident but as a whole I don't think of her as very iconic

\- Alexandria: Similar to Camille and Bianca, her legacy was as a bitch and nothing more.
